snippet.title: 🚀 Crankoids – Playdate Asteroid Shooter Gameplay! (Free Game)
snippet.description:
Crankoids is a fast-paced asteroid shooter for the Playdate console, inspired by classic arcade games! 🔥 Use the crank to aim and destroy asteroids, collect power-ups, and battle epic bosses!

✨ Features:

Crank-based shooting action
Exciting power-ups and upgrades
Intense boss battles
Local high score tracking
🎮 Download Crankoids for FREE on itch.io: https://aicoding.itch.io/crankoids
